briefdescription.para: Single-level view of a tower-polynomial ring: a DPoly plus a fixed working level and a Tower-flavoured ring_type typedef.

detaileddescription.para: Wraps the DPoly engine so the rest of the engine can treat a particular variable level as an ordinary ring with operations add / mult / invert / ... on elem = TowerPolynomial. create() is the factory that bundles characteristic, variable count, and extension chain into a fresh DRing. Used as the coefficient ring of the higher-level Tower class.
